layouts.best_for: Classic print ads, D2C hero creatives
layouts.description: Visual first, then caption, headline, body copy, brand signature — in the order the eye naturally reads.
layouts.eye_path: Top visual → caption → headline → copy → signature
layouts.name: Ogilvy Layout

layouts.description: Key elements placed along a Z scan path; call-to-action sits at the end of the Z.
layouts.eye_path: Top-left → top-right → diagonal → bottom-left → bottom-right CTA
layouts.name: Z-Pattern Layout

layouts.description: Attention headline, interest-building visual, desire copy, action button — the classic funnel.
layouts.name: AIDA Funnel

layouts.best_for: Brand storytelling, festive campaigns, emotional D2C
layouts.description: Sequential panels tell a mini-story: problem → product → happy outcome.
layouts.name: Story Strip (Multi-Panel)

layouts.description: Multiple products in a formal grid — the whole range at a glance.
layouts.name: Omnibus Grid

layouts.description: Products scattered at varied sizes in a festive, non-formal arrangement.
layouts.eye_path: Roam all four corners → center offer
layouts.name: Circus Scatter

layouts.description: Space divided by strong verticals/horizontals into color-blocked rectangles; product sits in one block.
layouts.name: Mondrian Blocks

layouts.description: Single dominant visual fills most of the frame; minimal text overlaid.
layouts.name: Big Picture Hero

layouts.best_for: Product pages, Amazon A+ style, feature ads
layouts.description: Product left, headline and benefit bullets right — the ecommerce default.
layouts.name: Product Left / Copy Right

layouts.description: Centered product on vast negative space; tiny headline below.
layouts.name: Centered Minimal

layouts.best_for: Sale posters, event promos, reels covers
layouts.description: Massive headline type dominates; product tucked in a corner or behind type.
layouts.name: Big Type Takeover

layouts.description: Frame split diagonally or vertically into two contrasting halves.
layouts.eye_path: Left half → right half → verdict CTA
layouts.name: Split Diagonal

layouts.description: Circular badge overlapping the product corner — offer/award callout.
layouts.name: Badge Overlay

layouts.best_for: Instagram stories, reels ads, WhatsApp status
layouts.description: Vertical frame: hook text top, product mid, CTA sticker bottom.
layouts.name: Story Stack (9:16)

layouts.best_for: YouTube pre-roll end cards, banner ads
layouts.description: Wide cinematic frame: product right third, headline left, CTA bottom-right.
layouts.name: Cinematic Thirds (16:9)

layouts.description: Portrait left, quote and name right, star rating above.
layouts.name: Testimonial Split

layouts.best_for: Price drops, EMI offers, combo deals
layouts.description: Old price struck through beside bold new price; product above.
layouts.eye_path: Product → new price → old price → CTA
layouts.name: Price Slash

layouts.description: Countdown numerals large, product emerging behind, date strip bottom.
layouts.name: Countdown Reveal

layouts.description: Three numbered steps in a row with icons; product strip on top.
layouts.name: Three-Step Strip

layouts.description: Product center, ingredient visuals radiating around with labels.
layouts.name: Ingredient Orbit

note: Ad layout patterns for the Etch Ad Studio. Classic patterns (Ogilvy, Z-pattern, Mondrian, multi-panel, omnibus, circus, AIDA) are documented advertising-design standards; modern patterns are standard performance-creative formats. See SOURCES.md.
